name: Plan@Job
description:
Plan@Job is the operations platform trade contractors use to run property maintenance work: jobs, quotes, scheduling, subcontractors, compliance documents and invoicing.

Connect it and you can ask about the work in front of you instead of going looking for it. Check which jobs are waiting on a quote, pull up a job by its reference, see what a property's history looks like, review quotes you have sent and what came back, and get the next action on an account that has gone quiet.

Everything runs as you, with your own company's permissions. A connected assistant sees exactly what you would see signed in and nothing more, and internal phase and subcontractor pricing stays internal. You approve what it may do when you connect it, and you can disconnect at any time from Settings, AI connections.

You need a Plan@Job contractor account to use this.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Plan@Job to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Plan@Job to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://planajob.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Plan@Job MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plan@Job lists 17 MCP tools, including account_readiness, create_follow_up, get_action_receipt, get_contact_history, get_job, get_lead_preferences, get_subcontracting_mission, list_contacts, list_jobs, list_service_categories, list_subcontracting_missions, and save_subcontracting_brief.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Plan@Job?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Plan@Job in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Plan@Job requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Plan@Job is developed by Planajob Ltd. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
